tests: @smoke Completes an order end to end and returns a confirmation
Empties the basket once the order is placed
symptom: Intermittent 400s from POST /api/Addresss/ and POST /api/Cards/ — "Validation len on zipCode failed" / "Validation min on expYear failed".
rootCause: Test data factories generated occasionally-invalid values: faker.location.zipCode() sometimes produced a non-5/6-digit format, and card.factory.ts used faker.date.future() for expYear, which can land below Juice Shop's server-side minimum. That minimum turned out to be a hardcoded 2080, unrelated to the current date.
fix: Pinned zipCode to a fixed 5-digit pattern in address.factory.ts. Rewrote expYear generation in card.factory.ts to a range of 2080-2099, matching the value tests/perf/checkout.js already used. Confirmed the 2080 boundary by probing POST /api/Cards/ directly with a range of years.

tests: @smoke A new customer can register and then log in
symptom: Test timeout of 45000ms exceeded clicking the security-question mat-label; log showed 79 retries all failing with "<mat-select> subtree intercepts pointer events".
rootCause: RegistrationPage.selectFirstSecurityQuestion() used clickUntilVisible() with the <mat-label> as the trigger to open the security-question dropdown. The label never opens the Angular Material select — only the mat-select trigger itself does — so the click was retried forever against the wrong element while the mat-select's own overlay intercepted pointer events.
fix: Changed the clickUntilVisible() trigger from securityQuestionLabel to securityQuestion (the mat-select itself), confirmed via playwright-cli that clicking the mat-select directly opens the option list. Removed the now-unused securityQuestionLabel locator.

tests: @smoke An authenticated user can add a product to the basket
symptom: expect(locator).toContainText() timed out with "element(s) not found" for locator('[matsnackbarlabel]'), even though the basket count in the UI had already incremented to 1.
rootCause: The [matsnackbarlabel] attribute selector no longer matches the app's current Angular Material markup. Using playwright-cli to click "Add to Basket" and inspect the live DOM showed the toast text actually lives in a .mat-simple-snack-bar-content span inside a snack-bar-container appended to the body.
fix: Updated ProductsPage.snackbar to locator('.mat-simple-snack-bar-content'). The existing /placed .* into basket/i assertion text was already correct for a first add (confirmed live) and was left unchanged.
